g.text: Japan: labor context and changes in domestic migration
Sources: Population Estimates (October 2022), LFS annual averages and Basic Resident Registration, CY2019 / CY2022.
Migration covers all nationalities; each annual prefectural net total sums to zero. Counts do not identify migrants’ ages.
Right panel selects extremes of change from all 47 prefectures; it is not a causal comparison.
